sources.title: Independent integer arithmetic and byte-position derivation
sources.details: 1+2=3 and 2+1=3 by counting; 4+4=8, 0+1=1, 1+0=1. The protocol string has 5 characters TOOL:, 10 calculator, 1 colon and 3 characters 1+2: 5+10+1+3=19 ASCII characters=19 UTF-8 bytes=19 ordinary byte-token generation positions, with EOS as one additional special token. Ordered parameter strings 1+2 and 2+1 differ even though their sums agree. Audit re-executed all applicable runtime sums and token encoding.
